entries.title: Crewmates on your other computers can use secrets, and another Mac can approve them
entries.body: A crewmate working on another of your computers can now ask to use a secret, as one on this computer does. The approval card says which computer the program runs on, a decision you save covers only that computer, and the program there gets the value only once you allow it. A Mac you paired can approve these uses too, each with its own Touch ID or password: turn on Approves secret uses on its row in Settings, Devices, then compare the code it shows with the one on this computer.

picture.alt: Settings, Devices, with Approves secret uses turned on for a paired Mac, and its Compare codes button below the switch.
